literal_meaning: গলায় বাঁধা বন্ধনী বা কুকুরের গলাবন্ধন
figurative_meaning_en: Collar; dog collar; bond of subjugation
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমরা কখনো গলবন্ধ গ্রহণ করব না।
example_sentences_in_english: He has lost his freedom by wearing the collar.
We will never accept the collar of subjugation.
history: References Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar's story 'Bagh o Kukur', where the tiger sees the collar mark on the dog's neck and decides not to sell its freedom by returning to the forest.
note: Idiom draws from 19th-century Bengali literature emphasizing themes of liberty.
